import random, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker
from stress import big_request

rng=random.Random(11)
for trial in range(5):
    req=big_request(rng, k=60, per=8)
    # force feasibility: big capacities, big budget, small demands
    for e in req["edges"]: e["capacity"]=1024
    req["budget"]=98304
    for c in req["commodities"]:
        c["demand"]=rng.randint(0,50)
    P=sum(len(c["paths"]) for c in req["commodities"])
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=(json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode(),capture_output=True)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    r=json.loads(p.stdout.splitlines()[0]) if p.stdout.strip() else {"status":"NOOUT"}
    errs,_=checker.check(req,r)
    print("trial",trial,"paths",P,"time %.2fs"%dt,"status",r.get("status"),"errs",errs[:3])
